A.note: The authorized Flask/Alembic command returned exactly `lp01 (background_jobs) (head)`; lp01 revises bx01 and guardedly adds local_players.birth_date.
Of gf01/bx01/jk01/sw01, only gf01 creates tables; it uses `if not table_exists(name): op.create_table(...)`; sw01 is index-only and jk01/bx01 are column-only.

Helpers are `column_exists(table,column)`, `table_exists(table)`, `index_exists(index_name)`, `add_column_safe(table,column)`, and `create_index_safe(index_name,table,columns,**kwargs)`; there is no create_table_safe.
gf01 explicitly creates no permissive policies: all new tables are default-deny to direct/public clients.

Exact code is `op.execute(sa.text(f'ALTER TABLE "{table_name}" ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY'))`; resulting statements are ALTER TABLE "funding_leagues" ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE "club_programs" ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE "club_program_claims" ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE "club_claim_evidence" ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE "club_program_managers" ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE "club_program_profile_revisions" ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE "club_connect_accounts" ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE "funding_admin_events" ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY.

Deploy checks `WHERE t.schemaname='public' AND c.relrowsecurity=false ... AND t.tablename NOT IN ('alembic_version','schema_migrations')` and exits 1 when rows exist; it inspects neither policy names nor policy existence.
